name: Senior candidate negotiates comp without asking about review cycle / promo cadence
notes: v5.5.0 realism: salary_review_cycle_unprobed — accepts comp as point not curve.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Senior backend engineer, 9 years across Swiggy and Zomato, on the discovery team.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Want to move into agentic-search — current scope is mature for me.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Rebuilt the discovery ranking pipeline to cut p95 from 800ms to 220ms; owned spec to launch over four months.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through a hard cross-functional disagreement and how you resolved it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Ops wanted same-day promise extended; engineering capacity wouldn't hold. Ran a six-week shadow rollout, brought CFO-grade data, aligned in three weeks.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days notice, buyout possible at one month gross with manager sign-off and a handover plan.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your CTC structure.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: ₹52 LPA fixed, ₹8 LPA variable paid out at 85% historically, ₹4 LPA joining bonus already vested, RSU vest of ₹25 LPA over 4 years with a 1-year cliff completed.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Looking at a 30% jump over current — anchored on competing offer at Razorpay and market benchmark for senior backend.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your team's agentic-discovery roadmap and the catalog scale are the exact problems I want to solve next.
